loudnorm.name: Match loudness
loudnorm.desc: Brings many clips or audio files to the same loudness (LUFS) in one go.
loudnorm.help: Pick a file or a folder and a target: −14 LUFS for Reels/Shorts/TikTok/Spotify, −16 LUFS for podcasts or −23 LUFS (EBU R128) for broadcast. Each file is measured and then corrected linearly, with peaks at most −1 dBTP. The picture is copied unchanged. Files already on target are skipped. Result: <name>.lufs14.mp4 or .m4a next to the original. Needs ffmpeg.
loudnorm.nothing_found: No video or audio files found.
